description: PADDING in the fill takes the next EOWs of the peer's sequence, which is CAPABILITY while the repeating set is empty.
note: As drc-capability-replaces-empty-ed4 but with 48-byte blocks. At 52000 the PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED in a type 8 D_PDU with EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (C-0426), leaves 23 bytes of the block, and the only addressee is recorded Ed4, so 2 PADDING D_PDUs (type 14, 11 bytes each with address size 3) fill it (C-0367, C-1154), to 0.0.1.3, EOT 10, each with the next EOW of 0.0.1.3's sequence (C-0373, C-1260): nothing owed, no recommendation and an empty repeating set, so CAPABILITY again; the last byte is the modem's zero fill. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 48 bytes and 4800 ms a block; the type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte CAS-1 C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) is 25 bytes, so the transmission is one block, 5550 ms, and every D_PDU in it starts in block 0: EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043), and the type 8 reception window 10 (C-0350). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 draws slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The link is made when the accept has been sent, at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100), with the timers of cas-make-called-accept.
